name: sheep-exe-js
description: The classic Sheep.exe (Screen Mate Poo / Stray Sheep) desktop pet, ported from the original Win16 binary to a JavaScript library for web pages.

scripts.extract: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/work -w /work python:3.12-slim python3 -I tools/extract.py Sheep.exe .
scripts.re:images: docker build -t sheepjs-tools docker/tools && docker build -t sheepjs-ghidra docker/ghidra && docker build -t sheepjs-browser docker/browser
scripts.re:disasm: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/work sheepjs-tools tools/disasm.py Sheep.exe re/code.asm
scripts.re:decompile: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/work sheepjs-ghidra /work/build/ghidra-proj sheep -import /work/Sheep.exe -overwrite -scriptPath /work/tools/ghidra -preScript PatchChkstk.java -postScript DecompileAll.java /work/re/decompiled.c
scripts.re:traces: for f in test/scenarios/*.json; do docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/work sheepjs-tools tools/emulate.py Sheep.exe $f test/traces/$(basename $f); done
